headline: Digi International Launches New 5G Cellular Extender
summary: Digi International announced the commercial launch of a new 5G cellular extender for enterprise connectivity applications.
why: Hardware product introductions in enterprise networking drive revenue growth and technological competitiveness in the telecommunications sector.

impacts.name: Digi International
impacts.why: New product launch expands addressable market in enterprise cellular hardware.
